title: yard.toml
description: What a Localyard project needs: runtimes, services, processes, env and how its site is served. yard.local.toml is layered on top for machine-specific overrides.

service.description: `true` to enable, a version like "16", or a table with a version and databases.

databases.description: Databases to create on first start (mysql and postgres only).

commands.description: One shell command, or a list run in order.

yard.description: Format version of this file. Newer formats need a newer Localyard.

name.description: The project's name; the site is served at <name>.test. No dots: set `domain` for a custom domain.

https.description: Serve the site over HTTPS with a locally trusted certificate.

runtimes.description: Language versions the project runs with. Localyard installs missing ones.

services.description: Machine-wide services the project uses. They start with the project.

kind.description: php: PHP-FPM from `root`. proxy: forward to a process. static: files from `root`. docker: a compose service.

root.description: php/static: document root, relative to the project (e.g. "public").

proxy.description: proxy: the [processes.*] entry that receives traffic.

processes.description: Long-running commands (dev servers, queue workers) supervised by Localyard.

run.description: Shell command, run with `sh -c` in the project folder (or `cwd`).

restart.description: When to restart it after it exits.

port.description: Exported as $PORT. "auto" picks a free port and keeps it.

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the project folder.

env.description: Environment variables for processes, `yard run` and `yard shell`. Values may use ${VAR} to refer to earlier ones and Localyard's (DB_PORT, PORT, ...).

setup.description: Runs on the first `yard up` and on `yard setup` (e.g. composer install, migrations).

service.description: Compose service that serves the site.

compose.description: Compose file, relative to the project. Unset finds compose.yaml or docker-compose.yml.
